description: ANBC Car Parking is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by OpenDataNI. Information on car parks provided by Antrim and Newtownabbey Borough Council, including location, number of parking spaces and charges. Coverage: OpenDataNI. The portal files it under the publisher OpenDataNI. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
